verdict.rationale: A long-time user reports that Raygun's client providers (SDKs) are open source, which let them write their own NancyFX provider. A comparison in the same thread lists an open-source codebase as a Sentry advantage, implying Raygun's core platform is not open. So only the client-side portion of the product's source appears readable, and the support rests on a single, old community mention. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of source availability, a named open license, and an open-source core service rather than only client providers.
